pages.title: Separate professions
body: Use /professions, /mining, /fishing or /farming to switch. Each keeps its own money, tokens, rare currencies, tool, enchants, parts, crystals, ranks and vault. Items and boosts cannot move between professions.
The courtyard is across the bridge behind the mine entrance. Mining refills leave the courtyard and its crops alone. Pets, robots and queued mining rewards stay with mining.

pages.title: Fishing
body: With the rod equipped, aim at the pond and right-click to cast. Wait for the bobber to dip and the Bite bar, then right-click again to reel in. Reeling early, switching professions or walking away ends the cast.
Sell catches and buy bait at the supplies table or /supplies. Larger fish sell for more; rod levels unlock rarer species. /tool opens the same enchants, parts and crystal menus as mining.
The first visit offers a guide with a Skip button. /tutorial opens it again; /tutorial skip hides the guide.

pages.title: Farming
body: Right-click an empty plot with your hoe to plant the seed selected in /supplies. The free watering can doubles growth speed. Right-click ripe crops with the hoe to harvest.
Start with nine plots. Hoe levels unlock carrots, potatoes and two plot expansions. Buy seeds and sell crops at /supplies. Farm coins pay for plots and seeds; farm tokens and gems pay for enchants.
Crops keep growing while playing another profession and keep their progress when saved. Offline time does not advance growth, and crops never wither. /tutorial can show or skip the guide.

pages.title: Getting started
body: New worlds offer a short tutorial for mining, inventory, enchants and rank-up. Choose Skip Tutorial to play without it.
Progress is saved with the world. Open /tutorial or Tutorial in the pause menu to see the next step, skip, or restart. Existing and development worlds can opt in.

pages.title: Mining and currencies
body: Mine blocks to earn money, tokens and pickaxe EXP. Spend money on ranks, tokens on enchants, and points in /pointshop.
Open /pickaxe for your tool, /inventory for items, and /settings for display and gameplay options.

pages.title: Ranks and prestige
body: Use /rankup to buy the next rank, or /rankupmax for every rank you can afford. At rank Z, open /prestige to review the cost.
Prestige keeps your pickaxe and items. Finishing the prestige cycle advances rebirth and opens more mine content. The menu shows your next requirement.

pages.title: Rare ore pockets
body: Fresh mines can contain very rare crystal ore pockets. Mining them awards crystals at your current drop tier.

pages.title: Mine guardians
body: Stone Guardians rarely awaken while manually mining with an advanced pickaxe. Open /guardian and choose Go to Guardian to reach one.
Mine the bright arm, then the other arm, then the head. The boss bar shows its health, exposed weak point and time left. Defeating it awards Point Shop points.
Menus and offline time pause the fight. Leaving or refilling ends it without rewards. Devmode can summon one with /test guardian.

pages.title: Rebirth mines and upgrades
body: Rebirth opens new regions in /mines. Each has its own ore layout; changing regions refills your mine.
/mineupgrades offers permanent ore and pocket upgrades. Purchases survive prestige and take effect on a fresh refill.
More ore means more token blocks and fewer money blocks. Pocket upgrades improve rewards when a discovery appears.

pages.title: Mining contracts
body: Accept a goal in /contracts, make progress by playing, then return to claim Point Shop points.
Contracts do not expire. Saving, prestige and rebirth keep your accepted goal; cancelling loses its progress.

pages.title: Challenge shafts
body: After your first prestige, /shaft opens challenge floors with changing mining conditions. Clear the displayed block target to earn rewards and descend.
Your normal mine is saved while exploring. Use /shaft to return; an unfinished floor loses its progress. Saving keeps your active run and depth record.
Automining and manual refills are disabled in shafts. Each floor lists any other restrictions before you enter.

pages.title: Enchants and EXP
body: Open /enchant to buy upgrades, grouped by Tokens, Rubys and Sapphires. Pickaxe EXP unlocks more enchants and crystal slots.
Drag token enchant books or Liquid EXP onto your pickaxe. Gem enchants must be bought with their own currency.
Use /enchantcolor to change lore colours, or /enchantcolor off to restore the defaults.

pages.title: Rubys and Sapphires
body: Buy RubyGreed with tokens to find Rubys while manually mining. Spend Rubys on SapphireGreed to start finding Sapphires.
Gem upgrades are long-term purchases. /enchant shows each unlock, currency and price before purchase. Area enchants, bombs and automining do not roll gems or robot fuel.
Drill digs toward the mine floor. FuelFinder supplies robots, and Jackpot can uncover items. Bought upgrades and gem balances survive prestige and rebirth.

pages.title: Endgame enchants
body: Late pickaxe levels unlock rare effects: Hyper Surge helps pet EXP, Adrenaline improves pet boosts, Rage speeds up area triggers, and Overdrive improves pickaxe EXP.
Rewind repeats recent income, Energizer activates an owned effect, Credit Finder finds shop points, and Jackpot finds items.
These trigger rarely and have cooldowns. Active timed effects appear as boss bars; /boosts shows the full list and /enchant shows unlocks and costs.

pages.title: Crystals and dust
body: Identify a crystal by using it or right-clicking it in inventory, then drag it into an unlocked slot in /crystals.
Convert spare crystals into dust. Use matching dust to preview crafting a higher-tier crystal.

The first three crystal slots can resonate when they hold identified crystals of one tier, T5 or higher. Match their boost types or use one of each. /resonance shows the combinations and your active bonus.

pages.title: Parts and tool prestige
body: Identify a part, then equip it in the matching Head, Binding or Rod slot in /parts.
Equip all three parts at the required tier to prestige the parts. This consumes that set and advances the tool tier; it is separate from rank prestige.

pages.title: Rename Tokens
body: Buy a Rename Token in /pointshop. Hold your pickaxe or pouch, open /rename, preview the name and confirm.
Hex colours such as &#b895d9Amethyst Pick work in names. Escape cancels without spending the token.

pages.title: Inventory and pouches
body: Drag items between inventory, equipment and storage. Matching items stack while keeping their metadata.
Right-click a held pouch to open it. /pv opens your vault, where you can buy and name extra pages.
/salvage, /bin and /trash turn eligible items into tokens.

pages.title: Robots and fuel
body: Rare mining drops and Jackpot can find sell, EXP or token robots. Equip one of each in /robots.
FuelFinder supplies Robot Fuel. Drag fuel onto a robot or choose Load Fuel. Robots only boost mining while fueled; idle and offline time do not burn fuel.
Upgrades cost gems and increase both the boost and fuel demand. Review costs in /robots. Returning a robot keeps its level and fuel.

pages.title: Pets and hatchery
body: Use an egg or drag it into /pets to start hatching. Mining advances it; drag a ready pet out to claim it. Equip a pet for its boost and feed it when ready.
/petmerge combines eligible pets. Rare hatch mutations can save robot fuel, improve egg discovery or add pickaxe EXP. Only the active pet grants its trait.
Traits stay with pets through storage and expeditions. Merging inherits the most common parent trait, or rolls for one if no parent has a mutation.

pages.title: Pet expeditions
body: Send spare pets through /expeditions for points, food and eggs. Species and unlocked regions determine their routes.
Mining advances trips. Return to collect a finished trip, or recall the pet early without rewards. Full inventory keeps the pet and rewards safely stored.

pages.title: Multipliers and rewards
body: Use multiplier items to activate them. /boosts shows your equipment bonuses and active effects; matching multipliers extend their duration.
/endmulti returns your active sell multiplier as an item. /combinemulti combines matching sell multipliers into a stronger one.
/rewards lists mining milestones. Mining income appears in a one-minute chat summary.

pages.title: Autominer
body: Use Automine Time items to add time, then open /autominer or /am. Buy speed upgrades in its menu.
/am start starts automining; /am stop stops it. Higher speeds consume more stored time. Manual digging and mine bombs are disabled while automining.

pages.title: Item filter
body: Hold the item you want to filter and open /filter. Add a rule for keeping, salvaging, applying or moving matching items to the vault.
Rules apply only to automatic drops. Manual transfers, equipment returns, purchases and crafted items stay in inventory.

pages.title: Point Shop
body: Spend mining points in /pointshop on eggs, multipliers, automine time, Liquid EXP, rename tokens and pouches.
The shop shows each item's price in points.

pages.title: Mine bombs
body: Hold a Mine Bomb and left-click to throw it. It explodes on impact or after its fuse; higher tiers clear a wider area.
Bombs pay money and tokens from removed blocks, without pickaxe EXP or area-enchant triggers. They cannot be thrown while automining or during a refill.

pages.title: Settings and HUD
body: /settings opens the world settings. Title and pause Settings include volume, GUI scale, FOV, Hand view, Tool angle, Left hand and key bindings.
Right Shift opens the HUD editor; F8 also works. Crosshair, held-item name and tool progress stay fixed. Escape closes menus directly to gameplay.
/scoreboard [on|off|toggle], or /sc, controls scoreboard visibility. This is saved with the world.
